title: TD Cowen: Democratic Congress Would Sink CLARITY Act for Two Years
summary: Bitcoin Magazine TD Cowen: Democratic Congress Would Sink CLARITY Act for Two Years TD Cowen’s Jaret Seiberg says a Democratic sweep of Congress would kill the CLARITY Act for two years, hand Elizabeth Warren the Banking Committee and let Democrats block Trump’s picks for the SEC and CFTC. This post TD Cowen: Democratic Congress Would Sink CLARITY Act for Two Years first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
